channel.title: TurboFlow Updates
channel.description: Company announcements and product updates from TurboFlow.

item.title: TurboFlow Raises $6 Million Seed Round Led by Pantera Capital
item.description: TurboFlow has raised $6 million in seed funding led by Pantera Capital, with participation from Susquehanna Crypto and Digital Currency Group.

item.title: Why Pantera Capital Invested in TurboFlow: Five Signals in Its Published Thesis
item.description: Pantera Capital's Investing in TurboFlow article explains its thesis around product convergence, APAC localization, market infrastructure, the team, and early traction.

item.title: TurboFlow Adopts Chainlink: Why Short-Cycle Event Contracts Depend on Price Infrastructure
item.description: TurboFlow adopted Chainlink to support continuous prediction markets for XAU, BTC, and ETH. This update explains the confirmed scope and the infrastructure questions that remain open.

item.title: TurboFlow Announces Strategic Liquidity Collaboration with Susquehanna Crypto
item.description: TurboFlow announced a strategic liquidity collaboration with Susquehanna Crypto focused on execution quality, liquidity depth, pricing efficiency, and market structure.
